pulse.text: **Quiet three hours** — no new models and no ranking changes since the overnight sweeps; the last frontier launch was **Grok 4.5 on Jul 8**. The freshest thread this sweep is economic, not benchmark: CNBC reports Chinese open-weight models now take **30-46% of US enterprise token usage** (up from ~11% a year ago), with **Z.ai's GLM-5.2 seeing ~80x customer growth** in its first week and Palo Alto's CEO arguing AI pricing must fall **~90%** — the 'cheaper, good-enough' trade hardening against the closed frontier. The AA-Index (v4.1) board is unchanged: **Fable 5 (60) · GPT-5.6 Sol (59) · Opus 4.8 (56) · GPT-5.5 & Terra (55) · Grok 4.5 (54) · Sonnet 5 (53)**. The one clock still ticking is **Gemini 3.5 Pro**, five days from its reported **Jul 17** target with no public API, model card or pricing yet (Polymarket ~82% to ship by Jul 31). Markets are otherwise flat — **Anthropic holds 93%** for best model end-July and GPT-6 ~92% by Dec 31.
